title: Review with judges from several vendors
body:
Operator 2026-10-27 (ADR 0014 D22): replace two of the three Codex judges in `krn review` with `codex review` and Claude Code `/code-review`; keep the red-first changed-test check and the exact-head record. Starts after red-first proves a real pair, so the new judges do not sit on empty evidence.
Acceptance: one review record holds verdicts from three distinct judge implementations on the exact head; panel and round-two rules work unchanged; each judge's raw output is kept with the record.
